description: This file defines data structures, enums, and classes related to distributed collective operations, including types for logging, matching, and representing collective communication states in a distributed training context. It also imports a logger and includes schemas for a flat database schema for process and collective info.

classes.name: Ref
classes.description: A generic reference class, possibly a placeholder for future extension.

classes.name: TypeInfo
classes.description: A NamedTuple that stores type name and fields, with a class method to create an instance from a type.

classes.name: MatchState
classes.description: An enumeration representing various states of matching for collective operations, including fully matched, mismatches, and undecided.

classes.name: MatchInfo
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the match state and optional culprit info, with string representation and property for state.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: A NamedTuple representing a group with id, description, and size.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: A NamedTuple representing membership info with group id and global rank.

classes.name: Traceback
classes.description: A NamedTuple representing a traceback with id and frames.

classes.name: Collective
classes.description: A NamedTuple representing a collective operation with various attributes including sizes, states, frames, and mismatch info.

classes.name: NCCLCall
classes.description: A NamedTuple representing an NCCL call with ids, collective info, group, rank, traceback, type, and sizes.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: A NamedTuple representing the overall database schema with lists of groups, memberships, tracebacks, collectives, and NCCL calls.

classes.name: EntryState
classes.description: A class to track the state of an entry, with methods for logging, converting to collective, and NCCL call representations.

classes.name: Op
classes.description: A class that parses and represents an operation from an event dict, including source/destination, sizes, types, and matching logic.

classes.name: MatchStateRecord
classes.description: A class to record matching state information, including expected, found, and candidate ranks, errors, and reset logic.
